markets.intro: The site's prediction and every market read the way bookmakers read them: the model's probability, the odds that would pay it at even value and the bookmakers' average odds; then the pick the model would place at every level of risk. Below, when the two teams score and concede, and how often they go over the lines for goals, corners and cards.
markets.disclaimer: These are numbers on the matches played and on the model's probabilities, not betting advice. Odds above the fair odds are not a sure win: they are an outcome the bookmaker pays more than the model thinks it is likely. Bet only if you are of age, and in moderation.
markets.hint: Poisson model on the expected goals of the two teams (attack and defence against the league, home and away, xG, form), translated into every market. Fair odds = 100 / probability. Bookmakers' odds from the data provider, refreshed every three hours until kick-off.
markets.modelHint: The same probabilities as the prediction, translated into every market. The most likely outcome of each group is highlighted. Fair odds = 100 / probability.
markets.fairHint: Probability {pct}%: odds of {odds} would pay it at even value.
markets.bandsHint: Goals scored and conceded in every quarter of an hour in the competition's matches (current and last season). Stoppage time counts with the half it closes. The blue background marks only the quarters above the average (16.7%) adding the two teams: where this match should move.
markets.firstHalfGoal: At least one first-half goal in {pct}% of matches
markets.scoredFirst: score first in {pct}% of matches with goals and then win {won}% of them

legend.peak: underlined the quarter of an hour they score most in
legend.heat: blue background = quarter of an hour with more goals than the average (a sixth of the total) adding the two teams, scored and conceded: the darker, the more action expected in this match. The percentage is each quarter's share

markets.linesHint: How often each team's matches go over each line, end with both teams scoring, without conceding or without scoring. In green the values that weigh (over 1.5 from 70%, over 2.5 and BTTS from 60%, clean sheet from 50%).
markets.setPiecesHint: Averages per match from the statistics on record. The expected values for the match add what each team does and what the opponents concede.
markets.expectedYellows: Expected yellow cards in the match: {value}
markets.base: Base: {home} matches of the home side, {away} of the away side, in the competition (seasons {seasons}).
markets.empty: No matches played on record for these teams in the competition: the market reading arrives with the first matchdays.
markets.oddsHint: Probability {pct}%, fair odds {fair}. Bookmakers: average {avg}, best {best} ({book}), {books} bookmakers.
markets.legendBook: book = average of {books} bookmakers, updated {at}; in green when they pay more than the fair odds
markets.noOdds: bookmakers' odds not available yet for this match
markets.heatHint: {pct}% of the goals in the two teams' matches, scored and conceded, come in this quarter of an hour.

advice.title: What the model would play
advice.hint: Three picks, one per level of risk: among all selections and their combinations across different markets (outcome, total goals, both teams to score) the one that pays most while staying above the level's probability: cautious from 78%, recommended from 62%, bold from 45%. The probability of a combination is computed on the model's exact scores, so the selections never contradict each other and a selection that narrows nothing is left out.
advice.note: Probability of the whole pick according to the model; fair odds = 100 / probability; "book" is the bookmakers' average odds, for a combination the product of the averages (≈, indicative: not every bookmaker accepts several selections on the same match). Not betting advice: bet only if you are of age, and in moderation.
advice.record: See the record of the suggested picks
